keyEvents.text: Tamimou Ouorou (CSKA Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Sidny Cabral, Trabzonspor. CSKA Sofia 1, Trabzonspor 0.
Noah Saviolo (Trabzonspor) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Wagner Pina (Trabzonspor).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, CSKA Sofia 1, Trabzonspor 0.
Bruno Jordão (CSKA Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Stefano Sensi (CSKA Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! CSKA Sofia 1, Trabzonspor 1. Mohamed Salah (Trabzonspor) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Batista Mendy with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Trabzonspor. Mustafa Eskihellaç replaces Benjamin Bouchouari.
Substitution, Trabzonspor. Fabinho replaces Melih Kabasakal.
Substitution, Trabzonspor. Ozan Tufan replaces Batista Mendy.
Substitution, CSKA Sofia. James Eto'o replaces Max Ebong.
